name: Green Guide — Guide to Safety at Sports Grounds
source: Guide to Safety at Sports Grounds (6th edition)

rules.title: Exits must pass the crowd within the emergency evacuation time
rules.subject: exitWidth
rules.note: 82 persons per metre per minute on the level, over an eight-minute evacuation. A ground whose exits cannot pass its crowd in that time is over capacity however large it is.

rules.title: Achieved evacuation time
rules.subject: egressTime
rules.note: Eight minutes. Simulated rather than calculated — read it alongside the hydraulic figure above, not instead of it.

rules.title: Crowd density must stay below the crush threshold
rules.subject: peakDensity
rules.note: Above roughly 6 persons/m² forward movement ceases and crush injuries become possible. Note the engine's own validated envelope is 2 persons/m² (ADR 0007), so a figure near this threshold is outside what the model has been shown to reproduce.
